name: padconsole
description: Plan game nights and find party games for your group: PadConsole suggests games by player count, occasion, mood or theme, and explains how to start with phones as controllers.

interface.longDescription:
PadConsole is a browser-based party game console: open padconsole.com on a computer, TV browser or tablet, and every player scans a QR code to use their own phone as the controller. No console or gamepads needed.

Plan a game night for any occasion (friends, family, kids, a couple, a birthday, an office event, Christmas, New Year's Eve or friends in different homes) and get an ordered playlist that fits your group and your time. Ask what to do or play at home for your number of players ("we are 4 friends at home, what can we do?") and mood (party and bluffing games, trivia, racing and fighting, co-op adventures, camera games), or search by theme such as football, horror or quiz. Each suggestion links to its game page.

You can also ask how to get started, which devices you need, or how friends in different homes can join the same game with voice chat.

Answers in English, Turkish, German, Spanish, Indonesian, Portuguese, Russian and Arabic.
